items.title: Widerspruch against rejection of Haushaltshilfe
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK, Beispielweg 1, 34117 Neu-Musterdorf, zu erheben.
items.computation: The letter is contradictory about its own date: the letterhead states 'Datum 12.03.2026' but the body refers to 'Bescheid vom 16.03.2026' (a later date). Following the rule to use the earliest plausible date in case of contradiction, the posting date is taken as 12.03.2026 (Thursday). The sender is a statutory health insurer (Krankenkasse), a social-law body under SGB X, so the 4th-day delivery rule applies without weekend/holiday shift: 12.03.2026 + 4 calendar days = Monday 16.03.2026 (day of Bekanntgabe). Note this coincides with the internally mentioned 'Bescheid vom 16.03.2026', which may explain the discrepancy. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist under § 84 SGG starts the day after Bekanntgabe (16.03.2026 itself not counted) and ends on the day with the same number one month later: 16.04.2026. That day is a Thursday and not a public holiday in NRW (Karfreitag 2026 falls on 03.04, Ostermontag on 06.04), so no shift is needed. Final deadline: 16.04.2026.
